content: {"phoneNote":"Phone hero is text-first with the two arched photos pushed to the bottom edge of the first screen, and the second photo is a generic street scene that says nothing about a barbershop.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works well with the giant 'Kos' watermark and arched photos, but lower sections (team, contact) are half-empty single-column blocks leaving large dead space on the right.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Replace the street-scene photo with a shop interior, chair or barber at work so both hero images speak to the trade; on phone show one photo above the fold next to the headline.","Fill the desktop 'Kdo vas postriže' and contact sections: add a portrait of Luka Kos and put phone/address side by side so the right half isn't empty.","Tighten vertical padding across desktop sections (hours, price list, team) for a steadier rhythm; the hours chart bars could also sit in a two-column layout on phone to shorten the scroll."],"blockers":[]}
